ignoreCommand: APPROVED=$(sed -n 's/^CI-approved source: //p' deploy-trigger.txt 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); SUBJECT=$(git log -1 --pretty=%s); PARENT=$(git rev-parse HEAD^ 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s' "$SUBJECT" | grep -q '^ci: deploy approved ' && [ -n "$APPROVED" ] && [ "$PARENT" = "$APPROVED" ]; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi
